name: evolve-skill
description: Create or update an agent skill so a durable behavior change lands in the right SKILL.md, with proposal-first approval. TRIGGER when: user asks to create/update/change a skill, "turn this into a skill", "make a skill for this", or gives feedback about how you should behave in future sessions. DO NOT TRIGGER for: one-off task requests, or edits to app/repo code (not a skill).
